title: This robot is already working in a Toyota factory 🤖👀 #trendingshorts #ai #tech #robot
description:
Walden Robotics just emerged from stealth with roughly $300 million in seed funding at a $1.1 billion valuation, with backing from some big names including Toyota.

Spun out of Toyota Research Institute in January 2026 and led by MIT professor Russ Tedrake, the company builds general-purpose robots that learn through real-world practice using Large Behavior Models.

Unlike rivals pursuing legged humanoids, Walden uses wheeled bases, citing factory safety standards and greater battery and computing capacity. 

Since February, one robot has worked eight-hour shifts at a North American Toyota plant, loading and unloading car parts, cleaning machinery, and kitting components alongside human teams.
